_: Every kind of user who can reach a page. Four strategies are shown; you will normally use one of them for every persona in a project.

personas.label: Signed-in member
personas._seeds: Entry points only this persona can reach. They are crawled in addition to the routes in the config.

auth._credentials: Any string field may be written as env:VARIABLE_NAME. Only the variable name is ever printed, so a failing run never leaks a password into a build log.
auth._waitForSelector: Something that only exists once signed in. Without it, deep-smoke waits for the URL to leave loginPath, which works but is less precise.

auth._path: A Playwright storage state file: cookies plus local storage, saved from a browser that is already signed in. Create one with `npx playwright codegen --save-storage=.auth/admin.json <your-url>`, and keep it out of version control.

auth._module: The escape hatch. Your own function receives the browser context and a page, and does whatever your sign-in needs: a token exchange, a one-time code, a redirect dance through an identity provider. See auth-module.mjs in this folder.
